answer: A delta registry charges every new agent a non-refundable formation fee and a bonded deposit that is slashed on proven collusion, so a farm pays the full price per head while one honest agent pays once. Registration also requires an opal attestation from an existing member who vouches for the new key and loses standing if it is later exposed as a clone. Because the ledger records the spiral of shared funding, auditors can cluster and eject linked identities.
